tests.name: Quick Check
tests.description: Timed check on Research Design & Ethics

questions.question: Describe different sampling methods and evaluate when each would be most appropriate.
questions.correctAnswer: Random: most representative but hard. Stratified: ensures diversity. Opportunity: quick but biased. Choice depends on: resources, need for representativeness, access.

questions.question: Explain the difference between reliability and validity.
questions.correctAnswer: Reliability = consistency (repeat, same results). Validity = accuracy (measures what it claims). Both needed: reliable but invalid = consistently wrong; valid but unreliable = accidentally right.

questions.question: A sociologist wants to study domestic violence. Evaluate the ethical issues.
questions.correctAnswer: Ethical issues: informed consent (victims may be too distressed), confidentiality (identifying abusers risks victims), protection from harm (discussing abuse may re-traumatise), right to withdraw, sensitivity.
